# tests/fixtures/merge-kit/origin-urls.txt
#
# The forge is never a committed field: merge-kit reads it from each repo's own
# `origin` remote, so a repo that moves between forges is picked up on the next
# run instead of going stale. This list is the truth table for that mapping —
# one origin URL per line, then the CLI it must resolve to, `-` for none.
#
#     <origin-url> <expected-cli>
#
# Consumed by tests/test-merge-kit-profile.bats and by setup.sh, which stamps
# these URLs onto the fixture repos.

git@github.com:acme/node-repo.git gh
https://github.com/acme/https-clone.git gh
ssh://git@github.com/acme/ssh-scheme.git gh
git@bitbucket.org:acme/ssh-clone.git bbkt
https://bitbucket.org/acme/go-repo.git bbkt
git@gitlab.com:acme/make-repo.git glab
https://gitlab.example.invalid/acme/self-hosted.git glab
ssh://git@codeberg.invalid/acme/unknown-host.git -
